NON_TEXT: I can only read text messages for now. Please type your request.
RATE_LIMIT: You have sent many messages in a short time. I will pause for a few minutes; a team member has been notified.
ESCALATED_HOLD: A team member will contact you shortly. Automatic replies are paused for this conversation.
ERROR: Something went wrong on our side — a team member will get back to you shortly.
PENDING_SUMMARY: {service} ({duration_text}) — {when}. You can cancel free of charge no later than {cancellation_window} before the visit. Reply {yes} to confirm.
BOOKED: You're booked: {service} ({duration_text}) — {when}. We'll send you a reminder the day before. To change or cancel, just message me here; you can cancel free of charge no later than {cancellation_window} before your visit.
BOOKED_INTAKE: Before your first visit, please complete our short intake and consent form (about {intake_time}): {intake_form_url}
SLOT_TAKEN: Sorry — that time was just taken by another booking. Nearby options: {alternatives}. Which one works for you?
EXPIRED: That offer has expired (we hold offers for {ttl_text}). Tell me the service and day again and I'll check availability.
ALREADY_BOOKED: You're already confirmed: {service} — {when}. Anything else I can help with?
REMINDER: Reminder: {service} — {when} at {business_name}. Reply {yes} to confirm or {no} to cancel.
REMINDER_CONFIRMED: Thank you — your appointment for {service} on {when} is confirmed. See you soon!
REMINDER_CANCELLED: Your appointment for {service} on {when} has been cancelled. Message me any time to book again.
CANCEL_PENDING: Cancel your appointment for {service} on {when}? Reply {yes} to cancel.
LATE_CANCEL_PENDING: Cancel your appointment for {service} on {when}? Free cancellation ends {cancellation_window} before the visit, so this will be recorded as a late cancellation. Reply {yes} to cancel.
CANCELLED: Your appointment for {service} on {when} has been cancelled. Message me any time to book again.
LATE_CANCEL: Your appointment for {service} on {when} has been cancelled. Free cancellation ends {cancellation_window} before the visit, so it is recorded as a late cancellation. Message me any time to book again.
REVISIT: Hi {name}, it has been {days_text} since your {service} at {business_name}. Would you like to book your next visit?
ESCALATED_REPLY: I've passed this to our team — a team member will contact you shortly.
